records.title: Baby Mama
records.summary: Single executive Kate hires working-class Angie as a surrogate; Angie turns out to be pregnant by her own boyfriend, and Kate unexpectedly conceives too.
records.pregnancy_outcome: Angie gives birth to a daughter (Stephanie); Kate has a daughter in the epilogue
records.pregnancy_note: Father: Angie's baby: her boyfriend Carl (not Kate's embryo); Kate's baby: her boyfriend Rob

records.title: Fargo

records.pregnancy_outcome: son William born; she marries Mark

records.title: A Quiet Place
